hints.title: Independent Hero Evaluations
hints.text: Each hero can defeat all monsters whose power does not exceed the hero's power, collecting their coins.

hints.title: Sorted Order and Prefix Sums
hints.text: Sort monsters by power ascending alongside their coins. Form a prefix sum array of coins collected up to monster index i.

hints.title: Bisection Query
hints.text: For each hero, use binary search to locate the rightmost monster with power <= hero power, and read off the prefix sum.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maximumCoins(self, heroes: List[int], monsters: List[int], coins: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        pairs = sorted(zip(monsters, coins))
        m = len(pairs)
        powers = [p[0] for p in pairs]
        pref = [0] * (m + 1)
        for i in range(m):
            pref[i + 1] = pref[i] + pairs[i][1]
        ans = []
        for h in heroes:
            idx = bisect_right(powers, h)
            ans.append(pref[idx])
        return ans
```

complexity.time: O(m log m + h log m)
complexity.notes: Sorting monster powers and binary searching for each hero query.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all monsters for each hero takes O(h * m) operations, timing out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m) auxiliary space for sorted powers and prefix sum array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Pair monsters with coins, sort by power, compute prefix sums, and binary search.
